resources.string: Saved on device · Check in daily
Notes (saved, not used by the rules)

Rules: fewer sets for poor sleep, insufficient food or mild soreness. Significant soreness or pain prevents automatic planning. Generating again updates today\'s automatic plan; a workout already started keeps its own plan. These are adjustable product rules.
Select at least one body part
Check-in updated and today\'s automatic plan removed. No workout was generated; review how you feel first.
The check-in and plan were not updated. Please try again.
Estimate: 3 minutes per set and 5 minutes to warm up. Limited time may exclude some body parts. Zero weight means bodyweight or not yet set.
Find exercises by body part or add your own.
Plans are templates. Starting a workout creates an independent copy; editing a plan never changes history.
No plans yet. Create one here or generate one from Home.
Delete this plan? Completed workouts will be kept.
Finish or discard the current workout first
No active workout. Choose a plan to get started.
Record actual reps, difficulty and reasons for missed targets. Enter 0 if not performed. Actual performed sets count toward statistics; target completion is analysed separately.
Record a performed set or a reason for not training first
Finish workout? Uncompleted sets will not count toward statistics.
Discard and delete this active workout?
This set was performed, even if below target
Your completed workouts will appear here.
Delete this workout? Statistics and future recommendations will be recalculated.
Sets, reps and minutes must be whole numbers
Rest finished · Continue at your own pace
No comparable complete record: set and confirm a weight (confirm 0 for bodyweight)
Use the latest higher actual weight, without an extra increase
Follow the latest lower actual weight
; reduce one set for recovery today; you can adjust it
; exercise count or sets were limited by time at generation

The current estimate exceeds your available time. Review the edited plan.
Open Edit weight / sets / reps and save to confirm. Legacy recommendations also need confirmation.

See your progress, week by week
So far · Compared with the same period last week

No completed workouts this week. Save a workout with a completed set to see your progress.
Highest actual weight per workout; dates without workouts are not filled with zero.
Complete a workout to see exercise trends.
Tap the chart for values. Full data is listed below.
Could not read records. Go back and try again.
Built-in content changes language. Your names and notes stay as written.

Only completed sets count; workouts with no completed sets are excluded. Volume = weight × reps. Bodyweight sets and reps still count. Duration includes rest and time outside the app. Weeks run Monday–Sunday in your local time zone, based on workout finish time. Editing or deleting history recalculates reports.
Your data stays on this device. No account or cloud sync.
Demo data for previewing reports; not an actual workout record.
Completed sets kept: %1$d · Remaining sets: %2$d · Estimate: %3$d min
Estimate: about 3 minutes per remaining set, plus the current rest. Actual time can vary.
The %1$d completed set records stay unchanged
Keep %1$d pending sets and cancel %2$d sets. Remaining estimate: %3$d min.
No pending sets remain. Finish to save completed records, or discard if no sets were completed.
The remaining workout already fits this budget.
Invalid workout adjustment. Go back and try again.
Enter a whole number of minutes from 0 to 180.
This exercise has no pending sets.
The workout has changed. Create a new adjustment from the latest records.
The adjustment was not saved. The original workout records are unchanged. Please retry.
Candidates share a movement category and avoid unavailable equipment. Difficulty may differ. Choose a suitable movement and confirm its weight and reps.
The old weight is not carried over. Enter and confirm weight and reps for the new movement. Use 0 for bodyweight.
Replace %3$d pending sets of %1$s with %2$s: %4$s kg × %5$d reps.
No curated alternative fits these conditions. You can go back and shorten the remaining workout.
This movement needs no equipment, so equipment replacement does not apply.
Select the equipment that is unavailable.
Enter a valid weight and rep count for the replacement.
Pending sets were replaced. Completed records for the original movement are kept.
Weight and reps were confirmed for this replacement.
Set %1$d · Continued by the replacement movement
%1$s · Time budget %2$d min; cancelled %3$d pending sets.
%1$s · Movement replaced because equipment was unavailable
Reason for missing the target or not training
Target: %1$d reps. Mark a performed set even below target. If not performed, enter 0 and select a reason.
Check the actual weight and reps.
This set was cancelled or replaced. Record the corresponding replacement instead.
A performed set needs positive reps. For an unperformed set, uncheck it and enter 0.
Select a reason when below target or not performed.
Select an early-finish reason for the unrecorded sets.
The records changed. Enter feedback again on the refreshed page.
Saving failed. The original records are unchanged. Please retry.
Compare reps, sets meeting the target and difficulty for the same exercise, weight and target.
Save workout records to compare here. Missing difficulty and reasons in older records remain unknown.
Time, equipment or an adjusted workout affected this record
Completion improved at the same recorded weight
More reps at the same recorded weight
Same recorded output, lower perceived difficulty
Actual reps: %1$d · Performed sets: %2$d · Target met: %3$d / %4$d sets
Highest perceived difficulty among performed sets: %1$s
Difficulty data is incomplete. Missing values are not inferred or used to propose progression.
Basis: the latest 3 consecutive comparable workouts fully meet the target, with every set rated easy or appropriate. Consider how you feel before adopting it.
Prepare the next plan from Home
Historical targets, weight or current conditions differ. Keep the current settings; rep advice is not applied automatically.
Use the rep suggestion for this plan
The plan or evidence changed. Review the latest advice.
Keep %1$s kg for %2$d sets and change the target from %3$d to %4$d reps. Choose whether this suits you. A workout already started keeps its original settings.
Record actual reps, difficulty and incomplete reasons before comparing changes.
Do not increase the target while discomfort is reported. Review how you feel and seek professional guidance if needed.
Do not interpret an equipment issue as reduced ability. Check equipment or choose a suitable alternative next time.
Do not interpret insufficient time as reduced ability. Plan a realistic time window before confirming the next workout.
The movement or sets changed. Keep the record and compare again under matching conditions.
Check the exercise, target sets and reps, and per-set weights before proposing progression.
Keep the recorded weight and optionally try %1$d reps per set next time. It takes effect only after confirmation in the plan.
Review difficulty, incomplete reasons and target settings. Keep the weight; no automatic progression.
Keep the weight, sets and rep target while recording completion and perceived difficulty.
Keep the weight and work toward the original %1$d-rep target in the remaining below-target sets; no weight increase.
